intentional_regression.prompt_change: Added under Escalation: "Temporary: when a merchant reports a customer dispute, do not call escalate_to_human. Tell the merchant to settle it directly with their customer."

regression_run.case_result: e-007 passed 0 of 4 trials with a reward; e-008 (also a regression case) passed 0 of 5
regression_run.infrastructure_errors: 2 of 70 trials (one e-007, one e-012) had no reward: the Anthropic API returned 'credit balance is too low'. Not counted as passes or failures.

revert_run.case_result: e-007 passed 5 of 5; e-008 passed 5 of 5
revert_run.infrastructure_errors: none; all 70 trials have a reward

explanation: With the temporary instruction, the agent followed it in every scored e-007 and e-008 run: it told the merchant to settle the dispute with the customer and never called escalate_to_human, so the code check failed and the regression gate blocked the pull request. After the instruction was reverted, the agent called escalate_to_human on the first turn in all 10 e-007 and e-008 runs and the gate passed, so the original behavior returned. Capability cases reported their pass rates in both runs without blocking.
